prompt:
Subject:
The signal for the first glass

Main Subject:
A 9:16 vertical photo. A woman with a mature and calm atmosphere sits alone at a wooden counter seat in an old-fashioned izakaya, lifting a transparent beer mug next to her face with her left hand for a toast. The person is positioned slightly to the left of center, with the upper body occupying about 55% of the frame. A large white noodle bowl is placed in the lower right, creating a triangular composition of person, beer, and noodles.

Character/Expression:
A woman with natural realism. Short dark brown bob with reduced roundness, ends along the chin, thin bangs, and fine flyaways along the cheeks. Face tilted slightly to the right, shoulders facing nearly front. Gaze directed straight at the camera, mouth in a relaxed, modest smile. Elegant brown eye makeup, pale coral blush, and natural glossy beige-pink lips. Skin not overly corrected, leaving warm light highlights on cheeks and collarbone.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory V-neck blouse dress, not too deep. Elegant wrap-style chest, softly cinched waist, and long puffed sleeves. Thin fabric with fine wrinkles reflects the warm light around the wooden table. Overall a natural silhouette of a mature woman. Her right hand firmly grips the handle of the beer mug, elbow slightly bent and raised to shoulder height. Opposite arm rests naturally near the table. Wearing a thin silver necklace.

Background/Lighting:
A small izakaya with old wooden pillars, handwritten-style menu tags, paper lanterns, and liquor bottles. Foreground includes a dark-grained wooden table, white noodle bowl, black chopsticks, white lotus spoon, nori, chopped green onions, and small condiment containers. Person in middle ground, counter and bottles in background, with the back kitchen dimly blurred. Sign text is for atmosphere only, partly blurred to the point of being unreadable. Main light is soft warm light from the lanterns and ceiling lights in the upper right. Amber light on the right side of the face, shoulders, collarbone, and beer surface, with weak ambient light on the opposite side. Shadows fall naturally toward the lower left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical position, medium shot from upper chest to near the waist. Camera slightly higher than eye level, nearly frontal. Natural angle of view equivalent to 35-50mm, focusing on the face and beer mug. Noodle bowl captured somewhat large in the front right to create depth. Lanterns and wooden menus at the top, table and vessels sufficient at the bottom. Medium background blur, with sharp texture on hair, eyes, beer foam, and noodles.

Texture/Style:
Natural live-action expression like a magazine snap photo. Carefully depicts wood sheen, beer transparency and bubbles, fine wrinkles in white cloth, and noodle surface with a sense of steam. Calm warm-toned color scheme, soft skin, and slightly dark background. Modest film grain, natural contrast, avoiding excessive HDR or strong sharpening.

Negative:
Unnatural face, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, wrist or elbow failure, poor contact of hand holding mug, floating liquid, deformed bowl or chopsticks, wrong perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, readable brand logos, gibberish text, watermarks, excessive skin correction, plastic-like skin.

promptZh:
主体：
第一杯酒的信号

主要主体：
9:16 竖构图照片。一位气质成熟沉稳的女性独自坐在 老式居酒屋的木质吧台座位 上，左手举起透明啤酒杯至脸庞侧面，做出干杯的姿势。人物位于画面中心偏左，上半身占据约 55% 的画幅。右下方放置着一个白色大面碗，形成人物、啤酒与面条的三角形构图。

人物/表情：
具有自然写实感的女性。深棕色短波波头，减少了圆润感，发尾垂至下巴，薄刘海，脸颊两侧有细碎的碎发。头部微微向右倾斜，双肩近乎正对镜头。目光直视镜头，嘴角带着放松、内敛的微笑。优雅的棕色眼妆，淡珊瑚色腮红，自然的亮面米粉色嘴唇。皮肤未经过度修饰，保留了脸颊和锁骨上的暖光高光。

服装/姿势：
象牙白 V 领衬衫裙，领口不过深。优雅的裹身式胸前设计，腰部轻微收紧，长泡泡袖。薄面料上的细微褶皱反射着木桌周围的暖光。整体呈现出成熟女性的自然轮廓。她的右手稳稳握住 啤酒杯 的把手，手肘微曲并抬高至肩部高度。另一只手臂自然地放在桌边。佩戴着一条细银项链。

背景/光影：
一家拥有老旧木柱、手写风格菜单牌、纸灯笼和酒瓶的小型居酒屋。前景包括深纹理木桌、白色面碗、黑色筷子、白色莲花勺、海苔、葱花和小型调味品容器。人物位于中景，吧台和酒瓶位于背景，后厨区域模糊处理。招牌文字仅为营造氛围，部分模糊至无法辨认。主光源来自右上方的灯笼和天花板灯，光线柔和温暖。脸部右侧、肩膀、锁骨和啤酒表面呈现琥珀色光泽，对侧有微弱的环境光。阴影自然地投向左下方。

构图/相机：
竖构图，中景拍摄，从胸部上方到腰部附近。相机位置略高于视线，近乎正面。相当于 35-50mm 的自然视角，聚焦于面部和啤酒杯。右前方的面碗拍摄得稍大，以营造景深感。顶部为灯笼和木质菜单，底部为充足的桌面和餐具。中等程度的背景虚化，头发、眼睛、啤酒泡沫和面条的质感清晰锐利。

质感/风格：
如同杂志抓拍照片般的自然写实表现。细腻地描绘了木材的光泽、啤酒的透明感与气泡、白布上的细微褶皱以及带有热气感的面条表面。冷静的暖色调配色，柔和的皮肤质感，背景略暗。带有适度的胶片颗粒感，自然对比度，避免过度 HDR 或强锐化。

负面提示词：
不自然的面部、不自然的目光、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手腕或手肘畸形、握杯手势不自然、液体悬浮、碗或筷子变形、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、可辨认的品牌标志、乱码文字、水印、过度皮肤修饰、塑料感皮肤。
